title: Ottoman Beds
descriptionHtml:
Shopping for a new bed this Black Friday? Every Eagle Bed ottoman bed is handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop and delivered free across Great Britain by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days, with 14-day free returns and Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.

A gas lift ottoman bed has a mattress platform that rises on gas struts and stays open by itself, so you can reach storage under the whole bed without taking the mattress off. Choose end lift if you have clear floor at the foot of the bed, or side lift if the foot sits against a wall. Our gas lift beds are handmade to order in our own Dewsbury workshop on solid wood frames, such as the Ottoman Gas Lift Divan Base from £220.99 (end lift), the Side Lift Ottoman Storage Base from £249.99 and the Cloud Teddy Bouclé Ottoman Bed from £376.99, delivered free across Great Britain by our own team. Want it built for you? Add room-of-choice assembly for £69.99.

Ottoman beds from Eagle Bed lift on gas struts to reveal storage under the whole mattress, ideal for bedding, suitcases and out-of-season clothes. Each is handmade to order in Dewsbury on a solid wood frame, from Single to Super King, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Not sure on colour? Order free fabric swatches, handmade in Dewsbury, free delivery across Great Britain.

Not quite right? Want a base for your own headboard? See ottoman divan beds. Prefer drawers? See storage beds with drawers.

Ottoman bed buying guide

End lift or side lift?

  • End lift — the platform opens from the foot of the bed. Best when you have clear floor space at the end of the bed. See the Ottoman Gas Lift Divan Base.
  • Side lift — the platform opens from the long side. Useful in narrow rooms or when the foot of the bed is against a wall. See the Side Lift Ottoman Storage Base and the Side Lift Open Ottoman Bed.

Base only or a full bed?

Choose an ottoman divan base if you already have a headboard, or a complete ottoman bed with a matching upholstered headboard, such as the Mayfair Ottoman Storage Bed, Bumper Ottoman Storage Bed, Florida Ottoman Gas Lift Bed or Cloud Teddy Bouclé Ottoman Bed. Many of our panel, wingback and Chesterfield designs in this collection are also offered with an ottoman base — check the options on each product page.

Ottoman or drawers?

An ottoman gives one large compartment for bulky, occasional items and needs clear space above the bed to open. Drawers suit everyday items and need floor space beside the bed. Compare storage beds with drawers.

Frequently asked questions

What is a gas lift ottoman bed?

It is an ottoman storage bed whose mattress platform is hinged and lifted by gas struts on each side. The struts take the weight of the mattress and hold the platform open while you reach the storage underneath. Gas lift bed, gas lift storage bed and lift-up storage bed all describe the same design. Read how ottoman beds work for more detail.

Is a gas lift bed hard to open?

The struts carry most of the weight, so you lift the platform by its handle and guide it back down to close. A heavier mattress makes the lid feel weightier. You need clear headroom above the bed and clear floor at the foot (end lift) or one side (side lift).

What are the downsides of a gas lift ottoman bed?

You lift the platform each time you need something, so it suits bulky, occasional items more than things you use every day; for those, storage beds with drawers are quicker. It also needs room above the bed to open.

Do you build the bed for me?

Free delivery is to your door or downstairs, by our own team. At checkout you can add Room of Choice Drop Off for £29.99, or Room of Choice Assembly for £69.99 if you want the bed carried to your room and built for you.

Do ottoman beds need a special mattress?

No. The platform takes any standard UK mattress in the matching size. A heavier mattress simply makes the lid feel weightier when you lift it.

What fits under an ottoman bed?

The storage runs under the bed, so it suits spare duvets and pillows, bedding, suitcases, out-of-season clothes and other bulky items.

How long does delivery take, and can I return a bed?

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales), made by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Returns are free within 14 days if the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging, and a faulty item is replaced free or fully refunded. See our returns policy.

What warranty do I get?

Every Eagle Bed comes with a 5-year warranty. See our warranty page for the full terms.

Can I spread the cost?

Yes. Klarna and Clearpay are available at checkout, subject to the provider's eligibility checks.
